paper-white.$description: Paper White — Page backgrounds, card surfaces, inverted text, and light navigation

ink.$description: Ink — Display headlines, logo marks, icons, and filled conversion buttons; the near-black creates the system's decisive contrast against Paper White

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Navigation labels, links, and secondary dark interface text

graphite.$description: Graphite — Body copy, explanatory text, and secondary content

ash.$description: Ash — Captions, trust statements, quiet metadata, and low-emphasis links

porcelain.$description: Porcelain — Hairline card borders, dividers, and pale neutral fills

stone.$description: Stone — Visible card outlines and quiet structural borders

butter-paper.$description: Butter Paper — Warm-tinted object tiles and selected audience-filter surfaces

sunlit-wash.$description: Sunlit Wash — Announcement-strip fill, soft decorative highlights, and the warm hero atmosphere

honey-line.$description: Honey Line — Borders around warm audience pills and promotional surfaces

amber-ink.$description: Amber Ink — Orange text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases

cloud-blue.$description: Cloud Blue — Pale blue object-card fills and background accents

blue-note-edge.$description: Blue Note Edge — Borders for blue-tinted note objects

lilac-note-edge.$description: Lilac Note Edge — Borders for lilac-tinted note objects

inter.$description: Display family for the 64px/700 hero and 48px/700 editorial transition headings. The -3% tracking makes broad, heavy letters lock into dense multi-line thought blocks rather than airy marketing headlines.

ui-sans-serif.$description: Interface and body family: 14px/500 navigation, 16px/500 buttons, 16px/400 body copy, 18px/600 feature headings, and 36px/700 section headings. It keeps UI labels compact while section type retains the same firm, close-set voice as Inter display.

jetbrains-mono.$description: Small structured text inside product-like objects and technical note content; its fixed-width texture distinguishes metadata and snippets from prose.
